overview_description.description:
Disty is an AI-powered B2B procurement platform built to make business purchasing simpler, faster, and more transparent. Based in Riyadh, Disty enables businesses across Saudi Arabia to source products, compare purchasing options, manage orders, and request custom procurement for items beyond the platform’s listed catalog.

The platform connects businesses with trusted local and global suppliers while bringing sourcing, purchasing, fulfillment, credit enablement, supplier access, and procurement intelligence into one digital experience. Disty serves corporates, retailers, factories, institutions, and growing businesses, helping procurement teams improve purchasing visibility, access better supply, and make faster, data-driven buying decisions.
